source_evidence: Companies subject to the proxy rules will typically provide detailed compensation disclosure, including a compensation discussion and analysis section, in their annual proxy statement.
answer: To research executive compensation for a domestic public company, search for the company in EDGAR and look for its definitive proxy statement, Form DEF 14A. Companies subject to proxy rules typically include detailed compensation information and a compensation discussion and analysis section in this annual proxy statement. If the disclosure is not in the proxy statement, or the company has not filed one, check its Form 10-K. For changes to compensation for certain executive officers, look for Form 8-K, Item 5.02.
